property_summary: Whenever Collect(am) succeeds, the caller's outgoing Ether transfer must correspond to an equal reduction in that caller's recorded balance, so the sum of balances(caller) and the Ether actually received by the caller is invariant; the buggy version can subtract the amount even when the outward Ether transfer fails/reverts.
change_summary: Replace the revert-on-failed-call branch with an empty-compatible success path, so a failed external call no longer reverts the balance subtraction.
